{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Swamp_slug_anatomy.png|thumb|300px|The Dagobah swamp slugs had both testes and ovaries]]
'''Testes''' were the pair of [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|reproductive]] glands that produced the [[sperm]] in certain [[Species/Legends|species]]. The female pendant of those glands were called [[Ovary|ovaries]]. Being hermaphroditic, the [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slugs]] of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] had both testes and ovaries located in the rear part of their bodies.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> In [[Human/Legends|Human]] males, the crotch area, where the testes were located, was a highly sensitive zone, and a blow landed in that area could prove quickly debilitating. To exploit that natural weakness, the Mandalorian [[Martial artist/Legends|martial artists]] developed a low blow technique called the "[[Keldabe handshake]]."<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> Similarly, a woman would sometimes slam her knee between a man's legs to rebuff his unwanted sexual advances.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
